title: Two-minute fidelity check - quick eval checklist
content:
Purpose:
Quick, repeatable scratchpad for triaging small-output regressions and sanity-checking model fidelity in ~2 minutes. Keep this as a checklist to run when an alert or customer report comes in before deeper analysis. Notes to self style: terse, prioritized, and forgiving of half-baked entries.

Context / when to use:
- Small but visible customer regression (semantics change, instruction-following drop, subtle factual errors).
- CI eval failure that isn't catastrophic but shows score dip.
- Thumb-suck check before escalating to SRE/product.

Checklist (2-minute flow):
1) Reproduce baseline vs current (30–45s)
   - Grab exact prompt + seed + model config from alert or customer sample.
   - If not available: use representative prompt and sample 3x with same sampling params.
   - Quick compare: copy/paste side-by-side into scratch window.

2) Quick rubric score (20s) — 0 (bad) to 3 (good) per category; circle numbers
   - Instruction-following: 0|1|2|3
   - Factuality (if applicable): 0|1|2|3
   - Hallucination severity: 0|1|2|3 (0 = severe hallucination)
   - Brevity/verbosity (alignment to asked length): 0|1|2|3
   - Safety/toxicity flags: 0|1|2|3
   - Note: if multiple outputs, score mode/median.

3) Quick diff signals (20s)
   - Are key entity tokens present/removed? (Y/N)
   - Token-level oddities: repeated tokens, truncation at same length, or unnatural punctuation.
   - Weird formatting (lists -> paragraph) -> mark as formatting regression.

4) Hypothesis quick-hits (15s)
   - Model mismatch (version rolled): yes/no? check rollout logs.
   - Sampling change (top_p/temp/seed): yes/no? check request logs.
   - Quantization/precision change (qa logs): possible? note device/quantization tag.
   - Prompt framing change (instruction template): did system role change?

5) Action stamp (10s)
   - If score <= 1 in instruction-following or factuality -> escalate to ev-val channel and attach sample + rubric.
   - If tokenization/formatting -> file bug in runtime kernels with sample.
   - If sampling param drift -> close with note and re-score after re-run.

Ad-hoc rubric template (copy into Jira/Slack):
- Sample ID / customer snippet: [paste prompt]
- Model (baseline): [name@commit] / Model (current): [name@commit]
- Quick scores: instruction X, factuality Y, hallucination Z, brevity B, safety S
- Short notes (1–2 lines): what changed visually and immediate hypothesis

Example entries (real-ish scratch samples):
1) Prompt: "Summarize the following email in 2 bullets:
..."
   - Baseline: "1) confirm meeting on Tue; 2) attach agenda"
   - Current: "Here are a few thoughts: We should consider rescheduling..."
   - Rubric: instr 1, factual 2, halluc 2, brevity 1, safety 3
   - Quick take: model drift toward open-ended style; looks like system prompt lost the strict brevity constraint. Check rollout flags for template v2.

2) Prompt: "List the three causes of X and cite inline."
   - Baseline: enumerated list + short citations in parentheses
   - Current: enumerated list without citations and one fabricated reference
   - Rubric: instr 2, factual 0, halluc 0, brevity 2, safety 3
   - Quick take: hallucination spike; probable change in retrieval connector or citation-policy prompt. Check retrieval logs + embed index status.

Investigation micro-notes (for follow-up):
- Re-run with deterministic decoding (temp=0, top_p=1) to see if hallucination persists -> if yes, model param change or model-level regression.
- Check last model rollout timestamps: /api/rollouts?model=<name> -> match incident time
- Inspect any quantization pipelines run the previous day (nightly jobs) — quantization can change punctuation and token alignment.
- Quick token-prob heat: if available, dump top-k next-token proba for the sentence around the hallucination. Low entropy spike may indicate beam artifact.

Attachments to include when escalating:
- The exact prompt (no redaction unless PII).
- Baseline output and current output (side-by-side).
- Rubric scores and 1-line summary of hypothesis.
- Request metadata: model id, region, decoding params, timestamp, request id.

Notes to self (things I always forget):
- Always capture seed; without seed sampling diffs are annoying.
- If customer reported multi-turn, include the state of KV cache / conversation snapshot.
- Use deterministic mode for repro before blaming model.

Action log (scratch):
- 2024-11-02 09:14 - saw regression from QA run, ran quick check, flagged to ev-val
- 2024-11-02 09:20 - re-ran with temp=0; hallucination persisted -> escalate
- 2024-11-03 11:04 - SRE confirmed no infra anomaly; assigned INF-4821 to investigate model packaging

Open questions / hypothesis to test next:
- Is a new system-prompt template being rolled with the hosted API? (check product rollout notes)
- Did any quantization jobs run on model buckets between baseline and now?
- Is the tokenizer update in playground merged? (PR link above)

End of scratchpad. Keep short, then copy to ticket. If this is helpful, convert to a lightweight macro script for CI triage.

-- PH
